Slow-cadence policy source — when the feed is empty in the window, flag as 'no items' rather than treating as fetch failure. 2026-05-08 audit: WebFetch returned 5 dated posts incl. French IT trade press (translate findings to English in brief).

Drill into individual reports for citation; never cite the landing page itself.
